name: todo
title: Todo
description: The step list for this request; the Lead and each agent keep their own. set: the whole plan in order, each step a short outcome (it replaces the previous list; the first open step is in progress). advance: closes the step in progress and starts the next. done, start and drop take a 1-based step number, for work out of order or given up. view shows the list.

done.description: set: how many of the leading steps are already finished (a plan set again part-way).
